## Known Limitations

1. Stage 10 (Flow-Rules Broadcast) is PENDING — requires Phase B/D ForwardEngine convergence.
2. Timer stage depends on timer actually firing during the observation window.
3. IM stage depends on an IM message being routed during the observation window.
4. Legacy fanout (session_update → surface-viewer) is hardcoded in router, not rule-driven.
